tasks.short: Draw conclusions and predictions from analyses

steps.what: Verify the study question, analysis population, data version, method specification and actual statistical summaries before interpreting them.

Compare estimates, uncertainty intervals, subgroups and specified sensitivity outputs in the statistical analysis software {OTHER}; configure native linked output views to reduce repeatedly locating the same results while retaining verification of denominators and analysis versions.

Draw conclusions or make predictions based on data summaries or statistical analyses, weighing uncertainty, missingness, multiplicity, causal limitations and whether prediction is justified for the intended population.
Write the interpretation note in {DOCS} and check its completed conclusions, uncertainty wording, population and output references against the actual analysis.
Save the exact checked interpretation note in the restricted study record in {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Configure native result views in the statistical software {OTHER} before writing custom tools. The biostatistician interprets complete outputs and writes the actual conclusion; no automated clinical decision or unsupported prediction is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Result navigation and scientific interpretation are mixed together.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked outputs can show comparable versions and sensitivity results together.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a statistical association supports the proposed conclusion.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician challenges inference and makes uncertainty explicit.

ambition.what: Compare an additional prespecified sensitivity result before accepting an interpretation.

tasks.altitude: Less result navigation gives more attention to robustness; scientific authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native analysis output views can organise specified results without deciding their scientific meaning.

assumptions: Boundary: interpretation of already-produced actual statistical outputs, not their original computation. Task 16265 owns fitting work; no calculation saving is counted again here.

The analysis producer supplies study ID, population, dataset version, model specification, estimate, uncertainty, denominator and sensitivity identifiers. The biostatistician checks actual outputs in s1 and manually resolves missing labels with the producer; no clean feed is free.
The existing interpretation note is authored in s4. Its ordinary final-content check supplies the requested save gate, without additional self-approval labour; edits invalidate the gate.
Shares and cuts are E1 scenarios, not measured baselines. Native functions are tested first; no processor runtime earns labour saving.
unknowns: Whether comparison views are already configured
research_questions: How much active time is locating comparable outputs rather than evaluating them?

already_counted.description: Source checks, result comparison, inference, actual note writing and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain output links and version labels.

approvals.approved_version: Exact interpretation note and study record checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10 less 1 upkeep yields net 9 when repeated output navigation exists. Already-linked outputs or difficult interpretation may yield zero gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect the actual clinical or survey dataset, dictionary and approved analysis specification, checking identifiers, repeated observations, units, missingness, exclusions and permitted access; resolve discrepancies without silently changing investigator data.
outputs: verified analysis inputs and unresolved issues

steps.what: Analyze clinical or survey data using longitudinal analysis, mixed-effect modeling, logistic regression or the justified specified approach in the statistical software {OTHER}; configure reusable parameterised analysis programs to reduce repeated setup, retaining variable mapping, program adaptation and failed-fit repair.
inputs: verified analysis inputs and unresolved issues

steps.what: Check fitted models against independent calculations or validated reference outputs, inspect convergence, residuals, coding, covariance assumptions and sensitivity specifications, and resolve or document failures rather than accepting an available coefficient table.
inputs: verified analysis inputs and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write the analysis run record in {DOCS}, recording dataset and program versions, model choices, diagnostics and unresolved limitations, and check the completed package against the actual runs.
Save the checked analysis programs, outputs and run record in the restricted study repository {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Test native reusable analysis programs in {OTHER} before building code around the study. Reuse specified setup and model commands, keeping actual data inspection, diagnostic judgement, independent checks and run documentation with the biostatistician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study-specific variable maps and model assumptions limit blind reuse.
tasks.enabler_now: Parameterised analysis programs can reuse tested operations for explicitly specified designs.
tasks.still_hard: Missing data, model misspecification and nonconvergence require statistical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician determines whether an apparently successful fit is defensible.

ambition.what: Run and inspect an additional justified diagnostic specification before completing a repeat analysis.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated setup leaves room for diagnostic investigation, without expanding clinical decision rights.

reach.learn: Track dataset provenance and controlled program versions.

evidence.claim: Specified statistical model commands and parameterised analysis programs can be reused while model diagnostics remain a human responsibility.

assumptions: Boundary: actual analysis from received study data to a checked saved run package. Data collection, method-plan writing and final scientific interpretation are distinct work and earn no saving here.

Data owners supply subject or response ID, observation time, outcome, covariates, units, missing-value codes, exclusions and dataset version. The biostatistician validates mapping in s1; absent fields prompt manual source clarification and documented query resolution, retained in s1-s3.

A novel method or unresolved data discrepancy uses manual programming and review; no model invents a method or edits source clinical data. Native statistical runtime is already automated and is excluded from the saving.
The ordinary completed-package check in s4 supplies the requested save gate; any program, data or output change invalidates it, with no added approval stage.
Shares and setup reductions are illustrative E1 estimates, not measured study baselines.
unknowns: Current program reuse and independent verification arrangements
Actual access and study validation obligations
research_questions: Which active setup operations genuinely recur across comparable analyses?

already_counted.description: Data validation, program adaptation, diagnostics, independent checks, actual run record and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain and regression-check reusable analysis programs and variable maps.

approvals.approved_version: Exact data/program/output versions and run record checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 less 2 upkeep yields net 13 for repeated active model setup. An already-reusable or novel analysis may give zero gain.

tasks.short: Write detailed analysis plans and research reports

steps.what: Verify the actual protocol objectives, endpoints, populations, estimands and approved methods for an analysis plan, or the checked analysis outputs and conclusions for a findings report.

Determine the detailed analysis-plan content or defensible report narrative, resolve ambiguity with the study team and specify missingness, multiplicity, sensitivity analyses and limits appropriate to the actual study.

Assemble repeated protocol identifiers, endpoint definitions, analysis headings and approved table references in {DOCS}; native templates and verified field reuse reduce copying without inventing methods or numbers.

Write detailed analysis plans and descriptions of analyses and findings for research protocols or reports in {DOCS}; after native field reuse, a bounded draft assistant may rephrase the biostatistician's explicit decisions and checked findings, retaining author edits.

loop.purpose: Draft prose from explicit scientific decisions without choosing methods or computing results
loop.input: Verified permitted source excerpts, approved decisions and populated document structure
loop.output: Draft paragraphs with source references and explicit unresolved items
loop.check: Biostatistician compares every methodological statement, numerical claim, limitation and omitted qualification with the originals in s5
loop.stop: At most two drafts; unsupported claims or unresolved ambiguity require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates populate fixed fields but cannot express study-specific explanations; use manual writing if prose volume does not justify a loop

steps.what: Review and correct the complete plan or report against original protocol decisions and actual outputs, checking scientific meaning, every number, uncertainty, analysis populations, omitted limitations, document version and intended recipients.
Save the exact checked analysis plan or report in the restricted study record {DOCS}.
Send the exact checked analysis plan or report to the authorised study-team recipients through {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} templates and controlled source fields first. A bounded prose draft can then express explicit scientific decisions, with full source-to-meaning review before separate final save and send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans and reports contain both reusable fields and consequential scientific explanations.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled document structures support reuse, and a bounded draft can remain subordinate to actual source decisions.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent paragraph can quietly alter an estimand, missingness rule or conclusion.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician determines methods and verifies the final scientific account.

ambition.what: No new reporting obligation or scientific authority is claimed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated assembly leaves more review capacity; the biostatistician remains accountable for the full document.

reach.learn: Bind study records and distribution to exact approved versions.

evidence.claim: Controlled templates and source-bounded prose drafts can support document preparation but require scientific review.

assumptions: Boundary: writing one analysis plan OR one findings report, not both serially. Original analysis and interpretation are produced in their own workflows and counted there; source verification and this document's content decisions remain here.

The study team supplies protocol ID/version, endpoints, population, estimand, method decisions and authorised recipients; the analyst supplies actual checked tables with output IDs. The biostatistician verifies and manually extracts missing source fields in s1-s2, with that effort fully retained.

No patient-level data or confidential source is sent to an unapproved assistant. If source access or permitted drafting cannot be established, use native templates and manual prose; no outsourced reviewer is assumed.
The completed-document review in s5 binds each requested save/send gate without extra self-approval labour. Any content, version or recipient change invalidates both gates.
Shares and draft reductions are E1 scenarios, not measured baselines. Final study approval by other authorities is outside the writing task and receives no saving.
unknowns: Permitted drafting environment and source confidentiality
Current template reuse and required institutional sign-offs
research_questions: Do controlled field reuse and source checks outperform manual drafting on representative plans and reports?

already_counted.description: Source verification, scientific decisions, draft editing, full meaning review and final actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain controlled templates, draft instructions and source-check examples.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final analysis document and study destination checked in s5
Exact final analysis document and authorised recipients checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 16.5 less 3 upkeep gives net 13.5 when repeated assembly and supported prose are substantial. Already-templated documents or rejected drafts may offer no net gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the clinical study's endpoint, target population, meaningful effect, variability or event rate, allocation, power, significance, attrition and design constraints with the actual study team and source evidence.
Choose and justify the sample-size method and sensitivity scenarios appropriate to the actual endpoint, dependence structure, analysis and study design.

Calculate sample size requirements for clinical studies in the statistical power-analysis software {OTHER}; configure native scenario tables and reusable inputs to reduce repeated parameter entry, retaining units, rounding, scenario mapping and unsupported-design repair.

Independently check sample-size results against validated examples or a separate calculation, inspect sensitivity to uncertain inputs and assess whether the study team's proposed enrolment is defensible.
Write the sample-size calculation note in {DOCS} with source assumptions, method, program version, results and limitations; check the completed note against the actual calculations.
Save the exact checked sample-size note and calculation outputs in the study record {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Configure native scenario calculations in the power-analysis software {OTHER} before building a separate calculator. Keep assumption elicitation, method choice, independent validation and the actual calculation note with the biostatistician.
tasks.previous_blocker: The arithmetic is routine but inputs and study design are not interchangeable.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scenario tables can reuse explicit validated parameters across calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Justifying uncertain effect sizes and matching the method to the real design.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician makes the assumptions visible and challenges unjustified enrolment targets.

ambition.what: Assess a second plausible attrition or event-rate scenario before recommending enrolment.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated parameter setup leaves time for sensitivity assessment; study approval remains with the authorised study team.

reach.learn: Validate design-specific power calculations and uncertainty assumptions.

evidence.claim: Specified sample-size formulas and scenario inputs can be computed by existing statistical tools without a model choosing the study design.

assumptions: Boundary: calculation and internal documentation, not protocol approval, recruitment or a clinical recommendation to a patient. Detailed protocol-report writing is task 16250; its manuscript is not duplicated here.

The study team and actual evidence supply endpoint, effect, variability/event rate, allocation, dependence, attrition, significance and power; s1 elicits and checks them, and s2 specifies method and scenarios. Missing assumptions stay unresolved until a human supplies justified values.
Existing engine computation is already automatic; only active repeated input/scenario setup loses time. Unsupported designs require manual statistical programming and checking, not guessed formulas.
The ordinary completed-note check in s5 supplies the requested save gate without added self-approval time. Any changed assumption, result or version invalidates it.
Shares and reductions are E1 scenarios, not measured study baselines; no named product or numerical case is claimed.
research_questions: How much active parameter entry repeats across justified sensitivity scenarios?

already_counted.description: Assumption elicitation, method choice, setup exceptions, independent checking and actual note/save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain validated scenario definitions and checking examples.

approvals.approved_version: Exact assumptions, calculation outputs and note checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 less 2 upkeep yields net 13 for repeated manual scenario setup. Existing parameter sweeps or a novel design may offer zero saving.

role.altitude: Reusable statistical setup and controlled document assembly reduce repetition while scientific judgement remains accountable.
reach: Learn reproducible data provenance and controlled document distribution.
